explanation: Scan multiplier bits and accumulate each selected shifted multiplicand. The Add helper uses XOR for sum bits and shifted AND for carries, recursively repeating until no carry remains.
timeComplexity: O(w^2) bit operations in the worst case for w-bit words; w=64 here.
spaceComplexity: O(w) recursive carry-propagation space, fixed for the word width.
